concerns.text: The plan downloads the full COCO 2017 train split (`https://huggingface.co/datasets/pcuenq/coco-2017-mirror/...`). This dataset contains > 118 k images and far exceeds the 7 GB RAM / 2‑core CPU constraints of the free‑tier GitHub Actions runner. Running full‑resolution inference on the entire COCO train set is infeasible within the ≤ 6 h wall‑clock limit. Either restrict COCO to a smaller validated subset (e.g., COCO val) or sample a manageable number of images that still provide sufficient dense‑scene examples.
